locator: I q.3 a.5 co., second proof: differentias quae sunt extra essentiam generis
interpretation: Read 'the differentiae are outside the essence of the genus' as: the genus is not said of its own differentia as belonging to what it is (the differentia does not fall within the genus' ratio). This matches Aristotle's 998b24-26 under the essential sense of predication (DISAMB-PREDICATION-OF-DIFFERENTIA).
